# ===== PRESET: SCARY HIGH (eerie / ghostly) =====
# Gate -> Pitch UP 5 semitones -> Thin, hollow, piercing EQ -> Grit -> Compressor -> De-esser

# Noise gate
VSTPlugin: Library "ATKExpander x64.dll" Attack 0.097959 Release 1 Threshold 0.531507 Softness 1 Slope 0.142134
# Level (offsets grit +5 dB and the removed low end)
Preamp: 6.5 dB

# Pitch shift: +5 semitones, 100% shifted (pitchproof)
# Pitch +5 st, formant +2 st (GForm: cleaner than pitchproof on speech)
VSTPlugin: Library "GForm.dll" Form 0.58125 Pitch 0.70625 Oversmp 0 MinFreq 0.163054 MaxFreq 0.7818 Gate 0.1429
# Thin and ghostly: strip away the body
Filter: ON HPQ Fc 180 Hz Q 0.707
Filter: ON PK Fc 350 Hz Gain -3 dB Q 1.0
# Hollow, unsettling midrange
Filter: ON PK Fc 1000 Hz Gain -2 dB Q 1.0
# Piercing, eerie edge
Filter: ON PK Fc 3500 Hz Gain 4 dB Q 0.9
# A little breathy air
Filter: ON HSC Fc 7000 Hz Gain 2 dB

# Grit: raspy edge (Density 0.7, 70% mix)
VSTPlugin: Library "Density364.dll" ChunkData "exSuPgAAAAAAAIA/MzMzPw=="

# Compressor
VSTPlugin: Library "TDR Kotelnikov.dll" ChunkData ""

# De-esser (keeps the piercing edge from getting painful)
VSTPlugin: Library "T-De-Esser 2.dll" ChunkData ""
